preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 2 and 200,000.
The number of queries is between 2 and 200,000.
The nodes ai and bi are between 1 and n.
The weight of the edge ci is between 1 and 1,000,000.
The graph is a directed graph, and ai is not equal to bi.
The type of each query is either 1 or 2.
The edge i is between 1 and 2n - 2.
The nodes u and v are between 1 and n.
The nodes u and v are not the same.

postconditions.description: The output for each query 2 is the length of the shortest path between nodes u and v.
